verdict.rationale: Vanta documents official, type-safe SDKs generated from an OpenAPI spec, including one for Node.js, Deno, Bun, and the browser. However, the SDK docs scope them only to the Auditor API, not the broader Manage Vanta API used for controls, documents, and custom tests. Missing for 10: SDK coverage of the Manage Vanta and other APIs, documentation of which languages beyond TypeScript are offered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Vanta publishes official, type-safe SDKs for the Auditor API. Each SDK is generated from the same OpenAPI specification
Developer-friendly, fully type-safe SDK for Node.js, Deno, Bun, and the browser.
